name: Zheleznogorsk (Krasnoyarsk Krai, Russia)
description: A red field charged with a golden bear tearing an atom apart — the bear's paws splitting the nucleus within orbiting electron rings.
history: Zheleznogorsk, a closed nuclear city founded in 1950, adopted the celebrated bear-splitting-the-atom arms and flag in the post-Soviet era; the design has become an internet-famous icon of civic heraldry.

features.symbolism: the Russian bear mastering the atom — Zheleznogorsk was a closed city built for plutonium production
